# Empty the Drawer

> Free electronics recycling in Surrey, BC, Canada. People can drop old laptops, phones, computers, monitors, TVs and other electronics in a locked drop box in Surrey, or book a free doorstep pickup anywhere within about 90 km of Surrey (Vancouver to Chilliwack, Squamish to the US border). Every device goes to the Electronic Recycling Association (ERA), a registered Canadian nonprofit operating since 2004, which wipes or shreds every drive, refurbishes what it can for charities, schools and care homes, and recycles the rest.

## Key facts

- Cost: free — drop-off, pickup and ERA's prepaid shipping labels are all free.
- Drop box: Surge Wholesale loading bay, 13060 80 Ave #108, Surrey, BC V3W 3B2. Open Monday–Friday 9am–4pm and Saturday 10am–4pm. The box is locked and emptied every evening.
- Doorstep pickup: book online at https://emptythedrawer.org/book.html in about two minutes. No account needed, and you don't need to be home on pickup day.
- Pickup area: Surrey, Delta, White Rock, Langley, Burnaby, New Westminster, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Vancouver, Richmond, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Abbotsford, Mission, Chilliwack and Squamish.
- Accepted: laptops, desktops, phones, tablets, servers, monitors, networking gear, gaming consoles and TVs — working or broken.
- Not accepted: household appliances (microwaves, kettles, vacuums, fans) and loose, swollen, leaking or damaged batteries.
- Data security: donors don't need to wipe devices first. ERA erases every drive with data-destruction software and physically shreds any drive that can't be wiped. Donors should remove SIM and SD cards.
- Outside the pickup area: use any ERA depot (https://www.era.ca/recycling-depots/) or a free ERA prepaid shipping label (https://www.era.ca/shippinglabel/).
- Contact: phone (604) 953-9883, email donations@emptythedrawer.org, or WhatsApp.

- [Home](https://emptythedrawer.org/): how it works, the drop box, what's accepted, pickup areas and FAQ.
- [Book a free pickup](https://emptythedrawer.org/book.html): four-step booking form.
- [Contact](https://emptythedrawer.org/contact.html): phone, email and WhatsApp.
- [Electronic Recycling Association](https://www.era.ca/): the nonprofit partner that processes every device.
